text: Private David Tuey is a British soldier appearing in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. During World War II, Tuey served with Popski's Private Army and with them participated in numerous raids on German targets in Tunisia.

Captain David Archer was a character in Call of Duty: Ghosts and one of the primary characters and the secondary antagonist of the Extinction saga. He is the leader of the Nightfall Program, and thus, the main antagonist of Nightfall. He is also a supporting character in Mayday and Awakening. He is mentioned through intel in Exodus. He had sent out a message to "Godfather" Castle about their plan, but they were unsure if it was really Archer, since the audio message was deemed as a negative match.
Demo Leader is a character in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, seen in the level "Induction". He is the leader of Demo Team One. He was killed along with the rest of the squad.
Daniel, also known as Iron Guard, is a character featured in Call of Duty Online.
Dan Jackson is the Digital Art Coordinator and Freelance Colorist at Dark Horse Comics. He worked on the Call of Duty: Black Ops III comic.
Petty Officer First Class Dan Lyall, also known as Wolf, is a playable character in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare.

Junior Lieutenant David Schorn is a character who appears in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and member of the Settlement Defense Front. He's assigned to the SetDef carrier Centauri. Schorn is killed by Nick Reyes in a dogfight during Operation Trace Kill.

Dave Stohl is a former Studio Head of Infinity Ward, who formerly worked at Neversoft and Treyarch. Stohl worked on games for the Call of Duty series including Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare. As of 2023, Stohl has been promoted to an Executive position at Activision Publishing.
Alice, also known as Death Angel, is a character featured in Call of Duty Online and Call of Duty: Mobile.
Demented Echoes are an enemy introduced in Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War Zombies as a jumpscare in the map Die Maschine, and appearing as an enemy in Outbreak.

Sergeant Daniel Take Yatsu is an Operator of the Hellhounds faction featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard and Call of Duty: Warzone. Daniel appears in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added on January 11th, 2024, as part of the Season 1: Soldier's Tale Battle Pass.

Dark Shepherd is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on August 21, 2020, during Season 9 Conquest as part of Hellon Shells Draw Later, during Season 7: Elite of Elite, Dark Shepherd appears in the Comics, being part of a mysterious organization called The Dark Covenant, and later Atlas Corporation.
Deadman is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on February 23, 2023 as part of the Season 2: Heavy Metal Battle Pass. Deadman also appears in the comics.
Darkwave is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on March 30th, 2023 as part of the Season 3: Rush Battle Pass.
David A. Foster is a character who makes a minor appearance in Call of Duty: Mobile. His file is found by Urban Tracker during Operation Spiderweb.
Sergeant Dave Lockhart is a character featured in Call of Duty 2.
Sergeant Dimitriy Petrov (Russian: Дмитрий Петров) is a tanker who works with Major Nikolai Badanov and Sergeant Fyodor Belinki, as seen during the events of Call of Duty: Finest Hour.
Private Doornink is a Dog Company soldier that appears in Call of Duty 2. He is a radio operator.
General Diego Almagro is the secondary antagonist in Call of Duty: Ghosts. He was the original leader of the Federation during its formation twelve years prior to the events of the game.
Dimarco is a playable character featured in Call of Duty: Strike Team.
Lieutenant Denisovich is a member of the Red Army in Call of Duty: United Offensive. After the Soviets take the factory in Ponyri, he appears carrying his PPSh-41.

The Destroyer is a special zombie that appears in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 Zombies map IX and in Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold Wars Dead Ops Arcade map, Dead Ops Arcade 3: Rise of the Mamaback. They are equipped with battle axes which they throw at the players.
Private Desmond Wilmot, also known as Des, is a character featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard.

Former First Lieutenant Denise McDaniels, also known as Foxtrot, is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on February 26, 2022, during Season 2: Task Force 141 as part of the Rogue Revenge Draw. Foxtrot also appears in the Comics.

Denise Michaels, also known as Rampage, is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on June 2nd, 2022 as part of the Season 5: Tropical Vision Battle Pass. Rampage also appears in the Comics, working with Foxtrot in the in the .
Private Dickinson was an American soldier in Fox Company who fought and died in World War II.
Private Donnie McCloskey was an American soldier of the 2nd Ranger Battalion who fought in World War II, as seen in the events of Call of Duty 2.
Private Dimarkurato is a Soviet operative that appears as a playable character in Call of Duty: World at War (Nintendo DS).
Private Derrick Warren was an 82nd Airborne Division operative that appeared as a playable character in Call of Duty: Roads to Victory.

Sergeant Edward Carlyle was a British commando who fought in the North Africa campaign during World War II, as seen during the events of Call of Duty: Finest Hour. He appears as a playable character in the game. He was put in charge of demolitions because of his degree in chemistry.
Private Elder was a soldier in the 82nd Airborne Division who helped Sergeant Moody and Private Martin, as seen during the events of the original Call of Duty.
Corporal Duncan Keith was a British Special Air Service trooper who served under Gerald Ingram and James Doyle.
Corporal Dunne was a top gunner for the American B-24, 'B' Flight number 1, as seen during the events of Call of Duty 2: Big Red One.
Colonel Dyke was a member (possibly the leader) of the Marine Rescue Team in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare (Nintendo DS).
Captain Dwight is a British S.F.S.G. troop who appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance. He serves alongside Brewer, Jenkins, and Andrews in Alaska.

Private Dravinski is a character in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare (Nintendo DS). He is seen in the mission First to Fight doing target practice for Sergeant Hichborn. He then leaves and enters the demolitions training building and soon disappears.

Drelick was a minor character in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, appearing in the level "Manhunt". He is an Atlas Corporation operative who was sent out along with Gideon, Ilona, and Jack Mitchell to assassinate Joseph "Hades" Chkheidze. After Mitchell kills the presumed target with a Sniper Drone, an ID check shows that this isn't Hades, and Drelick, seeing that the double is rigged with explosives, dives onto the body, shielding the other operatives from the explosion, but is killed himself in his act of heroism.
Lieutenant Junior Ebele Yetide is a character featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. Yetide is a crew member of the UNSA Retribution.
Commander Elijah Emerson is a character in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. Emerson is the leader of the Orion Initiative private military group.
Private First Class Drew Stiles is a character in Call of Duty: WWII. He is part of the 1st Infantry Division.

Eldermann is a minor antagonist in Call of Duty: Mobile. He was introduced in Season 1: Heist. After Vladimir Makarov escaped from Siberia, he recruited Eldermann and multiple others to assist him in requiring valuable data against his enemies. Alongside the rest of Makarov's heist crew, Eldermann broke into the Hacienda and eliminated the security guards alongside Garrett and Darling. After regrouping with Makarov, he declared him an imposter and proceeded to gun Eldermann down.
Elizabeth Liones (Kangi: エリザベス リオネス) is is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added on May 1st, 2025 during Season 4: Infinity Realm as part of the Elizabeth Draw.
Major Eileen is a character featured in Call of Duty Online.
Corporal Dwyer is a Canadian soldier that appears in Call of Duty 3.
Private Drucker is a character that appears alongside Rook in the mission "Bloody Nose Ridge" in Call of Duty: World at War (Nintendo DS).
The Exploder is a type of zombie encountered in Exo Zombies in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare.
Erica Muller is a minor character in Call of Duty: WWII. She is a German citizen caught in the crossfire between U.S. and Nazi forces in the mission Collateral Damage.
Major Howell was an American officer serving in the 82nd Airborne Division who fought in World War 2. He was featured in Call of Duty: Roads to Victory.
Gruppenführer Heinz F. Richter is a character in the Nazi Zombies mode of Call of Duty: WWII.
Higgs is a character featured in Call of Duty: United Offensive who is a member of the Sicily Raiders serving as the boat driver.
Jang-ui is a North Korean enemy lieutenant featured in the DMZ mode of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. He can be found in the Shopping District of Hajin.
Jin-tae is a North Korean enemy lieutenant featured in the DMZ mode of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. He can be found in Hajin.
Private Ju Kwon is a character featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. He is a South Korean Marine. Kwon is also featured as an Operator in Modern Warfare 4 and Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0.

Ivan Petrovitch (Russian: Иван Петрович) is a major Ultranationalist leader in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare (Nintendo DS). He is also the only antagonist to appear in the game, while the rest are only mentioned.

Private Joe Miller was a Marine Raider in the 2nd Marine Division, who faced The Empire of Japan during World War II in Call of Duty: World at War: Final Fronts. He is one of the four playable characters in the game. The other members of his squad are Polonsky and Carter, and he serves under Sgt. Roebuck.
Private Ivanov is a character that appears along with Dimarkurato in Call of Duty: World at War (Nintendo DS).
Captain Keirsey is an American officer serving with the 506th Parachute Infantry Regiment during World War II as featured in Call of Duty: United Offensive.
Private Kerensky (Russian: Керенский) was a Red Army soldier who fought in the Battle of Stalingrad in World War II. He is featured in Call of Duty: Finest Hour.

Sergeant Kendle is a character appearing in Call of Duty: Black Ops (Nintendo DS). He is in charge of the weapons room and will not let any person who isn't experienced enough on the battlefield to go in.

Sergeant Keegan P. Russ is a main character in Call of Duty: Ghosts. He is a former member of the United States Marine Corps and the scout sniper for the Ghosts. He is rather quiet and not very social around people, but is known to complete combat operations under extreme conditions.

Doctor Kassar was a character in Call of Duty: Ghosts Extinction mode. He was a surviving Nightfall scientist who worked for David Archer aboard Stormbreaker, acting as the interrogator of Dr. Samantha Cross.

Captain Khosi Siyada is a character who appears in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and member of the Settlement Defense Front. He's assigned to the SetDef warship Pavonis Mons. Siyada is killed by Nick Reyes in Operation Deep Execute during a meeting on the SetDef Destroyer Icarius. although if the player doesn't authorise Operation Deep Execute he is presumed to be alive.

Lieutenant Karl Drown is a character who appears in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. He's a member of the Settlement Defense Front and assigned to the destroyer SDS Iani Chaos. Drown is killed by Nick Reyes in a dogfight during Operation Safe Harbor.
Oberst Karl Fischer is a character in Call of Duty: WWII. He supplies Rousseau with explosives and is her contact when she infiltrates the nazi garrison in Paris.

Oberst Keller is a character featured in Call of Duty: WWII. He is an officer wearing grey uniform in the basement of the garrison. The player assumes control of Camille "Rousseau" Denis and is informed that Karl Fischer is in the basement after asking Oberst Huber or Baumann. The player can ask him is he Fischer or tell him the code phrase "Verlaine". If the player tells him the code phrase, he will ask Rousseau to give him her ID papers and ask her to state her name. If she responds "Hanna Muller" instead of "Gerda Schneider" she will be arrested, resulting in a game-over screen. After the explosives goes off blowing the garrisons' entrances Rousseau planted, Jeanne and Claude break of the

Kim Tae Young (Hangul: 김태영) is an Operator of the Harpy faction featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard and Call of Duty: Warzone. Tae Young was released during the Season Three content for Vanguard on June 12th, 2022 as part of the "Kim Tae Young Operator Bundle". Tae Young appears in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added on December 12th, 2024 as part of the Season 11: Winter War 2 Battle Pass.
Klepto is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on April 21st, 2023, during Season 3: Rush as part of the Writing Walls Draw.
Jun Takeshi is a character featured in the Call of Duty: Mobile comics.
Keyes was an 8th Air Force airman featured in Call of Duty: Roads to Victory.
Doctor Justin is a character featured in Call of Duty Online.

Julian Luo has been a level designer at Infinity Ward since October 2006. Previously, he was a community modder for [http://www.mobygames.com/search/quick?gamegroup=Call+of+Duty Call of Duty] series; known for his participation in the SWAT mod. His surname has been spotted in numerous locations throughout Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3.
Senior Lieutenant Kozlov (Russian: Козлов) was a Soviet officer and political commissar who fought during World War II as featured in Call of Duty. He appears only once during the level "Red Square".
Private Kovalenko (Russian: Коваленко) was part of Sgt. Yakov Pavlov's group in the mission "Pavlov's House". He assisted Pavlov in taking the apartment building.

Private Koppel was an American paratrooper assigned to the 506th Parachute Infantry Regiment who fought during World War II as featured in Call of Duty: United Offensive. Koppel was a member of Sergeant Jones' squad in Fox Company.

Petty Officer Laughlin is a character in Call of Duty: World at War who is seen in the mission "Black Cats." He is the Flight Engineer and assistant gunner on the plane. He looks to be in his 20s and wears a standard Naval Avionics Uniform with flight gear: a denim uniform, boots, gloves, a parachute harness, a cap, a headset, and a life vest. He helps Locke operate the Bow Turret and both left and right waist guns.
Landry is a non-playable character in Call of Duty: World at War. He appears in the campaign mission "Black Cats" as the radio operator on the PBY Catalina.

Private Konstantin Bagramyan (Russian: Константин Баграмян) is a Red Army soldier who manned a forward observation post during the Battle of Stalingrad during World War II, as seen in Call of Duty: Finest Hour.
Captain Kovics is a character featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops (Nintendo DS).
Kyra Mosley is a character in Call of Duty: Ghosts. She is a USAF specialist regarding the ODIN Space Station.

Lieutenant Knox is a character appearing in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. As second-in-command of the Sentinel Task Force, he worked with his commander Cormack to stop any threats from the KVA attacks on Seattle and across the globe from happening ever again, until the Atlas Corporation became too powerful and the dominant military force in America. He appeared in many missions to stop Atlas and the upcoming war plagued by Jonathan Irons vengeance theory. He fought bravely until his death in New Baghdad during Sentinel's final assault on Atlas.

Lieutenant Junior Lee Boggs is a character featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. He is a pilot stationed aboard the UNSA Retribution. He is considered to be one of the best Raven pilots abroad Retribution, with many crew members expressing their faith within him to land them to safety. He was killed in action trying to land Reyes's team onto a SDF base on Mars.

Pvt. Lao is a minor character in Call of Duty: WWII. In Collateral Damage, he is seen raiding the hotel that is filled with German soldiers. He gets into a struggle with a German soldier. Ronald "Red" Daniels can choose to save him or not.
Private Kopelson is a character that appears in Call of Duty: WWII.
Legion is a Boss class enemy encountered in Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War Zombies.

Kryptis, also known as the Dark Rider, is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile, introduced in the Season 7: Elite of the Elite Comics and was released as a playable character on October 12th, 2021, during Season 8: 2nd Anniversary as part of the Altered DNA Draw.
Kumo-Chan, also known as KUROHANA S-AD-V187, is a semi-autonomous drone that appears in Call of Duty: Mobile.

The Kommando Klaus is an enemy featured in the Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 Zombies map Reckoning. They appear during the Special Round, as well as during encounters for both the Gorgofex quest and the maps Main Quest. They are otherwise absent from normal gameplay.

is a retired United States Marine Corps Corporal. Kyle is featured as an Operator in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 and Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0. He was released on October 23rd, 2026, as part of the C.O.D.E. Valor Pack.

Lieutenant Ko Jin-Hyuk (Korean: 고진혁) is a character featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. He is initially Ri Ju-Young's right hand man and a trusted friend to Ri Seung-Ho, but after she assassinates her brother, usurps the throne, and launches an invasion of the South, he betrays her and defects. He can be briefly played in the mission Stranded.

Private Lamia was seen with Lockhart in the trenches of Pointe Du Hoc during the first mission. He was giving suppressing fire on a destroyed tunnel when he was hit by infantry leaving the tunnel. He used an M1 Garand.

Private Leroy Huxley was an American soldier who fought in the 29th Infantry Division and the 90th Infantry Division during World War II. Pvt. Huxley is featured in Call of Duty 3 and makes a cameo appearance in Call of Duty: World at War in a piece of artwork.
Commissar Letlev (Russian: Летлёв) is a Soviet commissar in the Red Army during World War II, seen in Call of Duty 2.
Private Leslie Baron was a Canadian radio operator in the Argyll and Sutherland Highlanders of Canada, part of the 4th Canadian Armoured Division, who appears in Call of Duty 3.
Private Luyties is a character featured in Call of Duty: United Offensive and was a member of the Special Air Service.
General Leonid Belov (Russian: Леонид Белов) was a soldier in the Red Army who served during World War II, appearing in the game Call of Duty: Finest Hour.
Private Locke is a British soldier from Call of Duty: Finest Hour. He is seen in the first two British missions, where he is the support gunner for Bob Starkey's squad.
Private Lewis is a character in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. He is a part of 1st Battalion, 1st Infantry Division.

Corporal Lozano was a Marine Raider under the command of Sgt. Tom Sullivan in the raid on Makin Atoll. He was seen on Makin Atoll shooting a Japanese officer out of a hut and over a balcony with an M1911, before joining the other Marines. Lozano was killed in battle shortly after. Lozano_shooting_a_japanese_officer_WaW.png|Lozano shooting a Japanese officer.
Private Lucas Gibson was an American soldier serving in the 80th Infantry Division in World War II under Sgt. Mason and Cpl. Tucker.
Sergeant Logan is a character appearing in Call of Duty: Black Ops (Nintendo DS). He appears in Killhouse to guide Sergeant Michael Shaw.
Lu Bu (Pronounced: Lü Bu) is a playable Chinese character in Cyborg Rising Mode of Call of Duty Online.
The Lung Boost Victim is a minor character featured in V.E.R.S.I.O.N..
Levi, also known as Cowboy, is a character featured in Call of Duty Online.

The Leprechaun Zombie is a special enemy that appears in Call of Duty: WWII. It is a zombified leprechaun, which was added to both Multiplayer and Nazi Zombies with Operation Shamrock & Awe from March 13th, 2018 to April 3rd, 2018. The Leprechaun Zombie functioned differently depending on if the player is playing Multiplayer or Nazi Zombies.

Second Lieutenant Lucas Riggs is one of the four playable protagonists and Operator featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard. Riggs can be unlocked for Call of Duty: Mobile as a playable character for free by logging in-game from November 5th, 2021 until December 16th, 2021.

SS-Oberst-Gruppenführer Leo Steiner is the tertiary antagonist of Call of Duty: Vanguard. He was a high-ranking officer within the SS and Nazi Party. During World War II, Steiner was the commander in charge of capturing Stalingrad. He would also ally himself with Hermann Freisinger in a planned coup to overthrow Hitler, and replace him with Freisinger.

Corporal Lewis Howard is a character featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard. First appearing in the campaign mission Numa Numa Trail, Howard was released as a playable Operator of the Trident faction in Vanguard and Call of Duty: Warzone on December 14th, 2021 during Season One as part of the "Orange Hornet Operator Bundle".
Major Lipton is a British paratrooper, who served in the 6th Airborne Division. He was featured in Call of Duty: Roads to Victory.

[https://www.youtube.com/iFerg Luke Fergie], also known as Ferg or iFerg, is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on January 11th, 2022, during Season 11: Final Snow as part of the Ferg Bundle. Ferg is an Irish Call of Duty: Mobile player and content creator with over 4.28 million subscribers on YouTube as of 2025.
Long Yun is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile. He was added on February 22nd, 2024 during Season 2: Lunar Dragon as part of the Lethal Azure Draw.

The Local Police Sheriff is a character featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II. He is a member of the Texas Police Department and is the one to stop Gomez from arresting Alejandro Vargas. He was killed by the Las Almas Cartel after an RPG was fired at them.

The Lion Mask VIP is a character from the Squid Game TV series. The Lion Mask VIP is featured as an Operator of the Rogue Black Ops faction in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 and Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0. He was released during Season One Reloaded of Black Ops 6 on January 8th, 2025 as part of the "Squid Game 2: The VIPs Tracer Pack Bundle".
Lyra is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile. She was added during Season 2: Digital Dawn as part of the Artificial Intelligence Draw. Lyra also appears in the comics.
Luca Marchand is a character featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. He is a smuggler working for the Las Almas Cartel. Luca is also an Operator in Modern Warfare 4 and Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0.
Private Lovonski (Russian: Ловонски) was a Red Army soldier who fought in the Battle of Stalingrad in World War II, as seen in Call of Duty: Finest Hour.
Lieutenant Leland Charles Whickam is a minor protagonist and a Ranger featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops Mobile.

The MI6 Officer is a character that appears alongside the SIS Chief in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3. He appears in the cutscene "Mind the Gap" while informing the SIS Chief of potential threats in London; he is then informed to contact the MI5 Director and to make her aware of the situation.

Private M. McCord is a character featured in Call of Duty: World at War and was a member of Miller's Reconnaissance Team. During the team's mission, they were captured by Japanese forces on Makin Atoll.
Petty Officer Mangin is an American Naval radioman who fought in World War II. Mangin is only seen in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One.

Private Martin is the playable American protagonist in Call of Duty. He served as Baker Company's sniper, demolitions expert, intel collector, and pathfinder. He is a young recruit of the 506th Parachute Infantry Regiment of the 101st Airborne Division, and is under the command of Cpt. Foley.
Private MacGregor is a young Scottish soldier who serves in the 7th Armoured Division during World War II in Call of Duty 2.

Sergeant Makarov (Russian: Макаров) is a Red Army soldier who was presumably pressed into the first wave of Soviet troops, however he was not killed because he stayed back behind the Stalin statue while dozens of his comrades were killed in vain either by German or Soviet machine guns.
Private Marek Ulan, also known as Beksa (Polish: crybaby), is a Polish tanker and radio operator featured in Call of Duty 3 under the command of Stan Jachowicz.
Marcel is a member of the French Resistance seen in the campaign for Call of Duty 3.
Sargent Maddock was a Squad Commander in Call of Duty: World at War: Final Fronts. He was the commander of Tom Sharpe's squad.
Lieutenant Marcus E. Washington was a character in Modern Warfare 2: Ghost.

Lance Corporal Maras is a character who appears alongside Bravo Nine in the mission "AMF" in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare (Nintendo DS). He gives the player an order to help reinforcements aid in the operation, and may be shot and killed by an unknown Russian soldier.

Mario Perez was the former motion capture artist for Infinity Ward that motion captured for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2. He started working with Infinity Ward in July, 2008 and eventually left the company in July 2010.

Sergeant Marks is a minor character in Call of Duty: WWII. He is a soldier of the second platoon who fights on the bridge on a river in the Hürtgen Forest. As a soldier of the second platoon, Marks was taken by William Pierson to assault Hill 493, he is last seen defending the bridge. Marks behind cover WWII.png|Marks behind cover while holding off a German attack.
Captain Mai Nguyen (Vietnamese: Nguyễn Mai), better known as the Survivalist, is a character within Call of Duty: WWII Zombies and member of the Bureau of Archaic Technologies.

The Marauder is a Heavy Gladiator-type zombie that appears in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 Zombies mode in the map IX. They later reappear in Dead Ops Arcade 3: Rise of Mamaback in Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War.
Marvin Pelfrey is a character featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard. He is apart of the in against the Imperial Japanese Army. He is under the command of Sergeant James Washington.
The Marine is the main playable character featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2: Force Recon. He's a United States Marine of Dog Company in the 32nd Marine Corps.

The Masked Manager is a character from the Squid Game TV series. The Masked Manager is featured as an Operator of the Crimson One faction in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 and Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0. They were released during Season One Reloaded of Black Ops 6 on January 5th, 2025 as part of the "Squid Game 2: Pink Guards Tracer Pack Bundle".

The Masked Soldier is a character from the Squid Game TV series. The Masked Soldier is featured as an Operator of the Crimson One faction in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 and Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0. They were released during Season One Reloaded of Black Ops 6 on January 5th, 2025 as part of the "Squid Game 2: Pink Guards Tracer Pack Bundle".

The Masked Worker is a character from the Squid Game TV series. The Masked Worker is featured as an Operator of the Crimson One faction in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 and Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0. They were released during Season One Reloaded of Black Ops 6 on January 5th, 2025 as part of the "Squid Game 2: Pink Guards Tracer Pack Bundle".
Quarter Master 2nd Class Madigan was a member of the U.S. Navy who appeared in Call of Duty: World at War.

Private Miles "Manny" Castillo (also known as "Max") was an American soldier of the Fox Company and is seen in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One. He was under command by Sergeant Hawkins on the level "An Easy Detail" in Mons, Belgium.
Sergeant Mike "Dix" Dixon was an American character in Call of Duty 3 and Call of Duty 3 (Mobile).

Private Miesha Korolov (Russian:Михаил "Миша" Королёв) was a Russian soldier from Call of Duty: United Offensive. He fought alongside the player, Yuri Petrenko, and helped him through chaotic battles in the Battle of Kursk. He seems to be closest to Yuri, and may have saved his life in the trenches by encouraging him to not stop moving. He fights in all of the major battles that the squad goes through, the only Russian levels he is not in are the tank levels where the player mans a T-34-85 Medium tank. Initially, he was in the in the 67th Guards Rifle Division along with his squad and then is reassigned to the 15th Guards like the rest of his squad after Yuri is reassigned to his old unit. H
Colonel Mikhail Zayev Petrenko (Russian: Михаил Заев Петренко) is a 45 year old Colonel in Red Army and commander of the 46th Guards Artillery Regiment in Call of Duty.
Private McLeod was an American soldier of Dog Company during World War II. He is featured in the American campaign of Call of Duty 2, being seen in all of the missions.

Private McLaughlin was a soldier of the 1st Infantry Division assigned to Fox Company who fought in World War II, as seen in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One. He only appears in the mission An Easy Detail.
Private Mills was a British combat engineer who fought during World War II as featured in Call of Duty.
Corporal Michael Dabrowa is a British Paratrooper who is serving with the 6th Airborne Division. He is a playable character featured in Call of Duty: Roads to Victory.
Milos Novak (Czech: Miloš Novák) is a character featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard, and its tie-in comic series. He is the protagonist and playable character in the mission Phoenix.

Sergeant Michael Shaw is a CIA-backed operative and main playable character in Call of Duty: Black Ops (Nintendo DS). He is one of the two soldiers the player must extract in the mission The Recovery Job. Shaw is also featured in the Zombies mode, where he serves as the default player on all maps.

Private Meyers G. is a character in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare (Nintendo DS). He is seen in the mission "Exodus" when he is pinned down by OpFor. Private Zach Parker then arrives and rescues him and Private James.
Captain Mercer is a US National Guard who appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance.
Colonel Mikhail Belov (Russian: Михаил Белов) was a minor antagonist in the Call of Duty: Black Ops: Declassified mission "Got Your Back".
Major General Miles is a character in Call of Duty: Strike Team.
The Merchant is a character in Call of Duty: Heroes. He may occasionally visit the player's base if they have built the Landing Zone. He will give the player Celerium for allowing him to land.

Lieutenant Matthew Tovar is a minor antagonist in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and member of the Settlement Defense Front. He's assigned to the SetDef destroyer Nerio. Tovar is killed by Nick Reyes in a dogfight during Operation Deep Execute.
Warrant Officer Maynard Griffin, also known as Griff, was an arms specialist stationed aboard the Retribution featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare.
is the main antagonist of the Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare Zombies mode, and appears in The Beast From Beyond as the true final boss of the entire mode.

Oberscharführer Metz was the commandant of the labor camp during World War II, and the main antagonist of Call of Duty: WWII. He was an extremely brutal and merciless man, beating and executing his prisoners for non-compliance, especially Jews for being a member of the Waffen-SS.

Second Lieutenant Matthew Weber is a playable protagonist in Call of Duty: WWII. He appears in the mission Battle of the Bulge. On December 25th, 1944, Weber's squadron of P-47 Thunderbolts were protecting a large number of B-17 Flying Fortresses during a bombing run over western Germany when they received a call for air support from 1st Platoon, 1st Infantry Division. They and the 9th Armored Division had been engaged by Wehrmacht and Waffen SS infantry and armor east of Bastogne, Belgium. The fighters and bombers came under heavy attack from Luftwaffe Messerschmitt BF109s, but Weber and his squadmates were able repel two waves of fighter assaults and escort the bombers to their target. Captain Mikhail Saburov (Russian: Михаил Сабуров), better known as Mountaineer, is a character within Call of Duty: WWII Nazi Zombies, officer of the Soviet Red Army and member of the Bureau of Archaic Technologies.
Mikhail Borisovich Petrov, also known as Misha Petrov, is a character featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard, serving as supporting character during the missions Stalingrad and Lady Nightingale.

Aviation Machinist's Mate 3rd Class Mateo Hernandez is a character featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard, first appearing in the campaign missions The Battle of Midway and Numa Numa Trail. Mateo was later released as a playable Operator of the Harpy faction in Vanguard and Call of Duty: Warzone on April 27th, 2022 with the Season Three update as part of the Battle Pass.
Meliodas (Kangi: メリオダス) is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added on May 1st, 2025 during Season 4: Infinity Realm as part of the Meliodas Draw.

Miles Ross is a caster and commentator, as well as host of the COD POD alongside Stephanie Snowden. Before he became a caster, Miles Ross was a professional gamer who participated in Call of Duty and Halo tournaments. In 2015, he became an esports talent for Australia and Asia Pacific events related to Halo, Call of Duty and later Overwatch. Between 2017 and 2019, he was also commentator, desk host and analyst for all major qualifier events part of the for Call of Duty: WWII, Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 and the World Championship. Mitsuhime is a character featured in the Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 Zombies mode. She is the spouse of Takeshi Masaki, the twin brother of Takeo.
Min-Hee is an Operator featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 and Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0.

Private Mikael Kirelenko (Russian: Микаэль Кириленко) is a Soviet soldier appearing in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. During the Second World War, he served with the 13th Guards Rifle Division and participated in the Battle of Stalingrad.

Private Moditch was a member of the Special Air Service. He was a part of Ingram's Sicily Raiders. Moditch's prominent role is was covering Doyle while he and his team took the bunker and held the motor pool underground. He was killed and flow off the kubelwagen when a German Panzer IV took out his Kübelwagen and took the rest of the soldiers the cliff. The player can see Moditch's body lying on the ground. He is not mentioned again in the game. Moditch's Corpse UO.jpg|Moditch's corpse.
Natasha is a young woman that Yuri Petrenko writes to during his combat in World War II.

Junior Lieutenant Moudy Hamo is a minor antagonist in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and member of the Settlement Defense Front. He's assigned to the SetDef warship NB Quirinis. Hamo was killed by Nick Reyes in a dogfight during Operation Blood Storm.

Naomi Mizushima (Japanese: 水島直美) also known as Manta Ray is a character featured in Call of Duty Online and Call of Duty: Mobile. Manta Ray was added in Call of Duty: Mobile on July 29th, 2020, during Season 8: The Forge as part of Days of Summer Crate.

Major Motoko Kusanagi is a character from the Ghost in the Shell franchise featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on August 4th, 2022 as part of the Season 7: New Vision City Battle Pass.
Musha is a playable character featured in the Doomsday Zombies mode of Call of Duty Online.
Private Monterro is a character who appears in Call of Duty 2.
Corporal Nichols is the main playable character of the American Campaign and one of the protagonists in Call of Duty 3. He proves himself to be an excellent marksman and hand-to-hand combatant.
Major Nikolai Badanov (Russian: Николай Баданов) is a playable character in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. Since he is a Major, he is one of the highest ranking playable characters in the entire series.
Captain Norman Delaney was a commissioned officer who fought in World War II and commanded Fox Company, as seen in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One.
Private O'Bryant is an American soldier in Fox Company of the 1st Infantry Division in World War II. He fights alongside Private Roger during the Battle of Kassarine Pass.
Private Neiwert is a character in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One. Private Neiwert was an American Paratrooper under the command of Cpt. James who fought in the Sicilian campaign during World War II.
Executive Officer Nora Salter is the deuteragonist of Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and a member of the SCAR Team 1.

was a goddess of fertility in Germanic paganism and featured in the Nazi Zombies mode of Call of Duty: WWII. Her pre-Roman statue is seen in The Darkest Shore and a stone carving of her can be seen in The Frozen Dawn.
Negrete is a character featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. He was a SDF tech officer stationed at the SDS Icarius and was killed by Nick Reyes during Operation Deep Execute.
The Necropincer is a Special class enemy featured on the maps Totenreich and Rex Infernus in the Zombies mode of Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.

Sergeant Noyce is a British S.F.S.G. troop and playable character who appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance. He assisted in the breaching of Hoover Dam to prevent Russian forces from compromising its interior. While at the same place, he and his British allies meet the same fate.

Sergeant Oleg Puskov (Russian: Олег Пусков) was a Russian soldier appearing in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. During World War II, he served with the 13th Guards Rifle Division and participated in the Battle of Stalingrad.
The unnamed pilot of the Sea Knight helicopter Outlaw 2-5, better known by his helicopter's callsign, was an easygoing American flier with a southern accent.

Private Oliveria is an NPC that appears in the mission "Exodus" in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare (Nintendo DS). He appears alongside the player as they drop down the building and proceeds to follow the player.
Oozers are a type of enemy in the Exo Zombies mode of Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare that appear in the map Infection.

Private Otero is a British soldier appearing in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. During World War II, Otero served with Popski's Private Army and with them participated in numerous raids on German targets in Tunisia.
Private Parker was a radio operator who fought during World War II.
Private Pavlichenko was a Red Army soldier who fought in the Battle of Stalingrad in World War II.
Private Lev Passar was a Red Army soldier who fought in the Battle of Stalingrad in World War II.
Flight Officer Paul VanAtta was an 8th Air Force airman. He was featured in Call of Duty: Roads to Victory.

Captain Patterson is a main character in Call of Duty: Black Ops (Nintendo DS). He participates in the Vietnam War and the Cold War as a Studies and Observations Group (SOG) operative, commanding Michael Shaw and Ruiz through many battles.
Sergeant Paige is a character appearing in Call of Duty: Black Ops (Nintendo DS). He appears in the level Killhouse.
PDF Officer (PDF Soldier in the subtitles) is an officer in the Panamanian Defense Forces who appears in Call of Duty: Black Ops II.

Owens is a minor character featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. She is the leader of the miners stationed at Vesta 3 prior to the attack on the asteroid by the Olympus Mons, which caused the asteroid to drastically move from its original position in the Mercury Cluster to the orbit of the Sun. She, along with a few other miners, were evacuated by SCAR/SATO Marines during a search and rescue operation. But with the destruction of Retribution and her and the rest of her miners not being seen on Mars it's very likely Owens was killed during the assault.

Paul Thomas Daniels is a character in Call of Duty: WWII. He was Ronald "Red" Daniels' older brother. While hunting for the wolves that went after his family's livestock with his brother, he was attacked by a wolf, to which he died from his injuries.

Captain Park is a character in Call of Duty: Mobile, added during the Season 4 Disavowed Update. The character was originally referred to as simply Park, but this was changed during the Season 13 Wint3r War Update.

Padmavati Balan is an Operator of the Sentinel faction featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard and Call of Duty: Warzone. Padmavati Balan appears in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added on December 12th, 2023, during Season 11: Siren Song as part of the Cloakshot Strongbox.
Captain Pantelias was an 8th Air Force airmen featured in Call of Duty: Roads to Victory.

Private First Class Park Hyun-Jun (Korean: 박현준) is a playable character featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. He is a South Korean Marine. Park also appears as a playable Operator in Modern Warfare 4 and Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0.
Pierre LaRoche is a member of the Special Air Service Free French branch, and is set to be second in command.

Private Polonsky is a character featured in Call of Duty: World at War. He is a United States Marine during World War II. He was assigned to the 1st Marine Division and fought under Sergeant Sullivan's and Sergeant Roebuck's command. His model was later used for Ultimis "Tank" Dempsey.
Private Polubencev is a character seen in the Call of Duty: World at War campaign mission, "Downfall".
Private First Class Peas is a soldier of the 2nd Ranger Battalion and Dog Company appearing in Call of Duty 2. He is seen in the level "The Silo".
Lieutenant Pearce is a British soldier who appeared in Call of Duty: Roads to Victory.
Pirate Five-Zero is the callsign of an Apache pilot and a playable character that appears in Call of Duty: Ghosts. He is playable in the mission Birds of Prey.
Doctor Pierre Danois is the tertiary antagonist in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. He first appears in the level "Aftermath".
Poindexter S. Zittermann is a playable character featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare Zombies. He is voiced by Seth Green.
The Pest is a special zombie featured in Call of Duty: WWII's Nazi Zombies mode.
Private Phillip Evans is a character featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard.

Pernell Lenny is a minor character featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard. He is apart of the and against the Imperial Japanese Army while in . He is under the command of Sergeant James Washington. He is killed during the final assault by a pillbox.
Edward, also known as the Pirate King, is an enemy introduced in Call of Duty Online in the Ultra Zombies map Zombie Island and appears in the Zombie Survival mode.
Private Perrins was a British Paratrooper serving in the 6th Airborne Division featured in Call of Duty: Roads to Victory.
Private Perry was a soldier serving with the Calgary Highlanders featured in Call of Duty: Roads to Victory.

Captain Price was a British soldier who fought during World War II. He fought in the 6th Airborne Division and the SAS in Call of Duty and Call of Duty (N-Gage). He also led a group from the 7th Armoured Division during Call of Duty 2.

The President of the United States is a character heard in the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 mission Iron Lady that discusses the location of Volk with Overlord. He later gives a speech announcing peace between the U.S. and Russia at the during the opening cutscene of Dust to Dust.
Sergeant Purcell is a character seen at the end of the mission Boot Camp, in Call of Duty: World at War (Nintendo DS).

Prophet is a character in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. He provides information to Jack Mitchell and other Atlas PMCs throughout the campaign. He is only heard in the missions Atlas, Traffic, Fission, Aftermath and Manhunt.

The QR-M5TR (or the Quartermaster) is a robot featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, found in the Quartermaster. Players are able to purchase and use supply drops and view their collections via the QR-M5TR.

Second Lieutenant Randall, more known for his actions while a Sergeant, was the leader of 2nd Platoon's 1st Squad in D Company of the 2nd Ranger Battalion. He was an American soldier who fought during World War II, seen in Call of Duty 2. He is based on the real-world Leonard Lomell, an American Ranger in World War II who landed at Pointe du Hoc.
Captain Ramirez is a U.S. National Guard who appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance.

Private Ramazanov (Russian: Рамазанов) is a character who fights with the player during World War II in Call of Duty: United Offensive. He aids the player in the mission "Trenches while they are traveling by truck to the front of the battle.

Radoslav Barkov is an antagonist featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, member of the Settlement Defense Front and commander of the SetDef Destroyer SDS Galaxius. He was killed by Nick Reyes during Operation Taken Dagger.

Sergeant Rabson was a character in Call of Duty: WWII. He fought alongside SSG. Augustin Perez during the level Collateral Damage. He and his crew were killed as his M4 Sherman was destroyed by an enemy Panzer IV.

The Raketenbrenner (English: Rocket Burner) is a special Zombie in Call of Duty: WWII. It appears as a boss in "Into the Storm", the first chapter of The Tortured Path. The Raketenbrenner is an advanced version of the Brenner, having a gravity shield that can only be disabled by heavy weapons such as mortar or artillery pieces. Once the shield is disabled, this will make the Raketenbrenner vulnerable to damage for a few seconds until the gravity shield reactivates. This has to be repeated until the Raketenbrenner is killed.
Ray Kibble is a character featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard. He is apart of the and against the Imperial Japanese Army while in . He is under the command of Sergeant James Washington.
Razor 1 Pilot is a character featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II. He is a member of the United States Marine Corps and piloted a Pave Low.

Lieutenant Ran Bing (Chinese: 冉冰), also known as RANBING, is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added to the game on April 3rd, 2025, during Season 3: Cyber Mirage as part of the Destiny Reborn Draw.
Private Rickerson was a member of the Able Company, 1st Infantry Division that appeared in Call of Duty: Finest Hour.

Sergeant Ridley is a British S.F.S.G. Troop that is playable in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance. He is never actually seen in game, although he plays vital parts in "Clean Up". He acts as the tech support for his team as well as the demolitions expert, being the one who has all of the charges as well as the one who hacks into the airport security.

Riddian Poe, also known as Grim, is a character in Call of Duty: Ghosts. He is a member of the Ghosts and the unit known as STALKER. He is mentioned to have gone missing or have been reported K.I.A. near Zones Romeo and Sierra in the third Rorke file.

The Reporter is an unnamed character featured in the Zombies modes of Call of Duty: Black Ops III and Call of Duty: Black Ops 4. He is heard in certain radio messages in Shadows of Evil, Der Eisendrache and Revelations in Black Ops III, and in Tag der Toten in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4.
Sergeant Richard Webb is a main character featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard.

First Lieutenant Reginald West is a character featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. He is an American Marine embedded alongside the South Korean Marine Corps. West is also set to appear as a playable Operator in Modern Warfare 4 and Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0.
Reece is an Operator featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 and Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0.

Chairman Ri Seung-Ho (Korean: 이승호} is a character featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. He was the newly appointed Supreme Leader of North Korea in 2026 until his assassination. He is playable in the level Assassins.
Private Rutherford was an American soldier of Fox Company of the 1st Infantry Division who fought in World War II. He is seen in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One.

Sergeant Roland Roger was an American soldier in World War II, serving in the 1st Infantry Division, Fox Company. He is also one of only two men who weren't killed, wounded or replaced in his squad. He served with his squad from Africa all the way up to Germany.
Private Romanov was a Red Army soldier who fought in the Battle of Stalingrad in World War II.
Lieutenant Roberts is an American Air Force character featured in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One. He is the co-pilot of the B-24, 'B' Flight number 1 in the level Liberators.
Private Robinson is an American soldier in Fox Company of the 1st Infantry Division in World War II. He was seen in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One.

Sergeant Roebuck is an American squad leader of the United States Marine Corps in Call of Duty: World at War. He is voiced by Kiefer Sutherland. He is mentioned by Robert McNamara in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 within the Zombies map Classified.
Sergeant Rooker was an American soldier of the United States Marine Corps during World War II. He is seen in Call of Duty: World at War.
Private First Class Rosetti was an American soldier who appeared in Call of Duty 2, and was a member of 1st Squad.

Second Lieutenant Roe is a soldier that lands shortly after Martin arrives. He appears in the original Call of Duty. He also appears while trying to rescuing Gerald Ingram at the camp. File:Lt. Roe at the camp.jpg|Roe in the camp wielding Thompson.
Robot was a British Task Force 141 operative that appeared in the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 mission, "The Only Easy Day... Was Yesterday".
Rojas' assistant is a character in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2. He is an assistant to Alejandro Rojas.
The Russian Prisoner was an inmate alongside Alex Mason and Viktor Reznov at Vorkuta.

Ruiz is a main character in Call of Duty: Black Ops (Nintendo DS). He is a member of Captain Patterson's squad and is a SOG operative. Ruiz is replaced by Yuri Raslov in 1967, but returns to the squad in 1968.
Private Rogers was a British paratrooper in the 6th Airborne Division. He went on a scouting mission in the level The Relief of Bastogne.
